_readme: §PER-CITY-MEASUREMENTS (L-662) — the three EXPENSIVE C63 axes (LEGISLATION 25 · ENVELOPE 20 ·
HEIGHTS 10 = 55 % of the ratified weight) are AUDITS, not config reads, so computeScorecard.mjs
will not score them without a committed, reviewable measurement record. Absent ⇒ not-assessed.
Modelled on measurements/murcia.measurements.json, the first such record in the repo.
⚠ `status: 'measured'` is the ONLY key that unlocks an axis. Never set it to make a number appear.
⚠ Every figure below is CITED to an artefact or a probe run. INV-3: cited derivation, never a guess.
⚠ THE ENVELOPE AXIS IS NOT THE COVERAGE HEADLINE. Barcelona's dossier has long quoted ENVELOPE as
'56.0 % → ~60.7 %'. That is COVERAGE — the share of buildable land that gets ANY envelope. The C63
Axis-4 SCORE is Σ(share × tierWeight), and Barcelona's coverage is NOT uniformly `block-constructed`:
the 20a/* family is a native `setback` pack and the clau-18 OV route is expressly capped at
`estimated-ruleset` by SIG-3, both weight 0.4, not 0.7. Coverage 60.6 % scores 36.5 %.

_denominator.source: LIVE, RE-RUNNABLE query against the AMB Refós de Planejament ArcGIS REST service, 2026-08-01: https://geoportal.amb.cat/geoserveis/rest/services/qualificacio_refos_3857/MapServer/16/query?where=CODI_INE%3D%2708019%27&groupByFieldsForStatistics=CLAU_URB&outStatistics=[{"statisticType":"sum","onStatisticField":"SHAPE_Area","outStatisticFieldName":"area"}]&f=json
definition: PRIVATE BUILDABLE = the 24 PURE (non-composite) clau codes the layer returns for CODI_INE='08019'
that the PUBLISHER'S OWN renderer files under `Zones en sòl urbà` / `Zones en sòl urbanitzable`,
plus `22@` (a Barcelona private buildable zone the metropolitan renderer files under `Zones i
sistemes no recollits en el PGM` because it is the MPGM 22@ 2000 instrument, not the PGM).
⚠ The classification is the AMB's, read off `drawingInfo.renderer.uniqueValueGroups` — NOT a
judgement made here. Systems, Collserola and non-urbanitzable soil are EXCLUDED from the
denominator entirely (L-656: not-applicable ≠ 0 %), never scored zero.
⚠ 43 of the 89 codes are COMPOSITE overlays (`18-6a`, `7b-13a`, …). They are excluded from both
numerator and denominator as transcription overlays of an underlying qualification, not distinct
legal qualifications. Their combined area is 0.6 % of the city.
CROSS-CHECK: this reproduces MASTER-ROI-TRACKER §0.6 to the second decimal on EVERY headline clau
lands the denominator at 31,794,683 m² against §0.6's 31,801,618 m² — 0.02 % apart, two runs of the
same census. ⚠ It CORRECTS §0.6 on two rows: the ten-strong `20a/*` family is 11.13 %, not 10.62 %
(and Barcelona carries EIGHT of the ten subzones — `20a/6` and `20a/7` do not occur here), and the
`15/16/17*/14a/14b/8a` tail is 4.83 %, not 3.58 %. Both corrections move the numbers DOWN or

envelope.denominator: private buildable land = 31,794,683 m² (L-656 — buildable land, NOT all land, NOT clicks). See `_denominator` above.
envelope.source: live AMB Refós `QU_Trames` per-clau area census (2026-08-01) × the shipped tier of each clau's registered pack in `packages/site-parcel-data/src/rulepacks/registry.ts`
note: TEN NON-OVERLAPPING slices covering 100.00 % of the buildable denominator, so measuredShare = 1.0
and nothing is renormalised away. Score = Σ(share × tierWeight) = 0.36526.
⚠⚠ THE TIER IS WHAT THE CODE SHIPS, NOT WHAT THE DOSSIER HOPED. Every Barcelona pack declares
`defaultConfidence: 'estimated-ruleset'`; `ZoningRulesEngine.ts:957-963` promotes it to
`block-constructed` IF AND ONLY IF the derivation carries an `alignment.depthBinding` row — i.e.
only for the three `block-derived-alignment` claus (13a, 13b, 12). Consequences, both measured:
• `20a/*` registers `kind: 'setback'` (esBarcelona20aAillada.ts:535) and can never emit that row,
so its 11.13 % scores 0.4, not 0.7. MASTER-ROI-TRACKER §0.6's `56.0 % × 0.7 = 39.2 axis pts`
applied the block tier to this family too; that is a 3.3-point over-statement of the axis.
• the clau-18 OV route is expressly capped by SIG-3 (`sources/VERIFICATION.md`, DOES NOT
AUTHORISE: 'promoting the confidence tier above estimated-ruleset'), so its 4.62 % scores 0.4.
⚠ THE BLOCK-DISSOLVE SPLIT IS AN EXTRAPOLATION AND IS LABELLED AS ONE. L-676 measured the
PRODUCTION dissolve over a census of two Barcelona bboxes — Eixample 104/108 blocks, Ciutat Vella
74/77, pooled 178/185 = 96.22 % — and a dissolve failure reaches
`refuseConstructionIncomplete('block-dissolve-refused')` (siteDispatch.ts:4307) and publishes NO
envelope at all. So 3.78 % of the block-derived families' land carries a pack that cannot solve.
That is PRYZM's own gap, not a cited legal refusal, hence `no-pack` and not `not-determined`
(EnvelopeAxisWeight.ts keeps the two words apart deliberately). ⚠ 185 blocks in two bboxes is not
a city-wide rate and 13b's fabric was never sampled; the ratio is applied to all three block-derived
claus because omitting it would score them as if the dissolve never failed. It moves the axis DOWN
by 1.19 points. Re-measure per family before quoting it as a per-clau fact.
⚠ THE 39.4 % OF NOT-DETERMINED IS THE CORRECT SCORE, NOT A PENALTY (C63 §1.5 / L-656). Every one
of those slices reaches a TERMINAL, cited state naming the governing article: 18 → Art. 306;
22a → Art. 350.1 (~2,595 Pla Parcials); 22@ → Art. 8.1 MPGM 22@ (DEC-1, permanent); 12b → Arts.
320.3a/320.2a, the *tram de vial* is undefined and delegated to a *pla especial* (L-676, permanent);
bare 20a → Arts. 314.5/338.2, a missing SELECTOR not a missing rule (L-673); tail → derived plan /
verd privat protegit. Under the ratified definition of CLOSED they are closed. They are not envelopes.
⚠ THE CEILING RESTATED, AND IT IS LOWER THAN THE DOSSIER SAYS. `CLOSURE-REGISTER.md` carries an
ENVELOPE ceiling of '~68 %' (coverage). That figure was built from §0.6's clau-18 RANGE of
+4.0…+7.8 axis pts (≈ 5.7–11.1 pp of coverage) — an estimate the SIG-3 audit then SUPERSEDED with a
measurement: 26.4 % of clau-18 land = 4.62 pp, corroborated over all 1,282 clau-18 polygons and 800
live points. It also still counts `12b`'s 2.44 pp, which L-676 closed as a PERMANENT cited refusal —
exactly the DEC-1 logic that removed `22@`'s 2.06 pp and lowered the ceiling once already; nobody
applied it the second time. Corrected COVERAGE ceiling = 56.01 (packed) + 4.62 (clau-18 OV) + 1.55
(bare 20a, which reopens on a subzone-granular DATA layer, not on law) ≈ 62.2 %, not ~68 %.
Corrected AXIS ceiling ≈ 37–38 %: no tier above `block-constructed` (0.7) is reachable for a
constructed Art. 242.2 depth (EnvelopeAxisWeight.ts — `authoritative` needs a determination ISSUED,
`structured` needs the authority to publish the numbers AS DATA; Barcelona does neither), and the
only headroom left is bare 20a at 0.4 plus the ~3 of 7 dissolve failures that are a fixable refcat
block-IDENTITY defect. ⇒ **Barcelona's ENVELOPE axis is measured at 36.5 % against a ~37–38 % cited
ceiling. It is AT its ceiling, and the 22 missing points are LAW.** That is a more useful statement
than '60.7 % against ~68 %', and every point removed here is a point we were never entitled to claim.

legislation.source: docs/04-reference/jurisdictions/es/es-ct/08019-barcelona/sources/VERIFICATION.md (SIG-1/2/3) + the live AMB Refós clau enumeration recorded in `_denominator` above
note: DENOMINATOR = 24, the PURE private-buildable clau codes the zone-GIS actually returns for INE
08019 (live AMB Refós census 2026-08-01: 89 distinct CLAU_URB, 46 pure / 43 composite, of which 23
sit in the publisher's own `Zones en sòl urbà`/`Zones en sòl urbanitzable` groups, +`22@`). This is
the municipality's inventory, NOT the packs we authored — scoring cited/authored would report
~100 %, the 'Barcelona-borrow' trap C63 §3 Axis 2 names.
NUMERATOR = 11: the packed claus that the inventory ACTUALLY CONTAINS — 12, 13a, 13b and the eight
20a subzones. ⚠ THREE PACKED CLAUS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT COUNTED because Barcelona's zone-GIS never
returns them: `13E` (registered against 13a, returned ZERO times in 1,014 MUC resolutions and absent
from the AMB census) and `20a/6` / `20a/7` (subzones I and III, which do not occur in this
municipality). Counting a pack for land that does not exist is the same fabrication one level up.
⚠ SENSITIVITY, STATED: including the 43 COMPOSITE codes that touch a buildable zone (`18-6a`,
`7b-13a`, …) would give 11/38 = 28.9 %. They are excluded as transcription overlays of an underlying
qualification rather than distinct legal qualifications — the choice that RAISES the score, so it is
named here rather than left implicit.
⚠ documentInRepo: TRUE, and this is PROVEN not asserted — `git ls-files` confirms all four primary
instruments are committed and tracked: `PGM-NNUU-metropolitana.pdf` (the base NNUU + the
Barcelona-exclusive Arts. 342/343 at printed pp. 177-188, which is where the 20a family's numbers
come from), `corpus/pdf/DOGC-4893_2007-05-29_…_BARCELONA.pdf` (the binding Art. 327.2a/328.2a
annex), and both `RPUC_2006-025790-B_…` documents. This is a genuine advantage over Murcia, whose
publisher returns HTTP 403 to automated requests so its quotes cannot be re-read from the repo.
⚠ WHAT `documentInRepo: true` DOES NOT MEAN: the 20a family's in-repo source is the MMAMB
RE-EDITION of the 1988 text refós — manually re-typeset, with transcription errors documented in
that same volume (Arts. 251.3a, 330, 331) — not the DOGC original and not Barcelona's own 08019
consolidation. The document is retrievable; its fidelity is a separate, open question.
⚠ supersessionChecked: FALSE, and it is the register's only P0-adjacent open row (CLOSURE-REGISTER
#9). 1,755 RPUC instruments → 773 → 147 post-2007 PGM-level; 46 must be read, 3 read and cleared,
41 unopened, and 2009/036679/B (art. 264) is an IMAGE-ONLY SCAN that failed the digit-integrity
gate. `laterModifications: none` is written nowhere and must not be. signedVerification TRUE covers
SIG-1/2/3 only; a signature is not a supersession audit.

heightsLod.source: tools/context-height-probe/probe.mjs --at 41.3874,2.1686 --name barcelona --half-deg 0.06 against the SHIPPED R2 tiles (buildings.pmtiles?v=L659a — the same bytes the browser reads, the same provenance ladder) — 2026-08-01, verdict `unmeasured`, 900 tiles covering / 632 read / 268 absent / 0 FAILED
note: ⚠ measured-lidar = 0 across 101,542 footprints. `measuredMarkerCount: 0`. Not one building in
Barcelona's shipped context tiles carries an MDS-sampled height. The 503 `tagged` are OSM-surveyed
`height` tags, not MDS samples — C63 §3 Axis 6 v1 counts `tagged` ONLY, so the axis scores
503/101,542 = 0.50 %. `derived-levels` (62,940 = 62.0 %) earns NO partial credit until the C63 §8
founder decision lands; giving it 0.5 here would be this record ratifying a weighting the founder
has not.
⚠ assumedFraction = 0.375 — 38,099 footprints render a FABRICATED 9 m default, city-wide. This
SUPERSEDES the 33.7 % in CLOSURE-REGISTER #17, which is not wrong but is a different, SMALLER
measurement: the register's run used the default `--half-deg 0.008` NEAR ring (6,306 footprints,
25/25 tiles) around the Sagrada Família point. Re-run today for continuity and it reproduces
EXACTLY — 6,306 footprints · 0 measured-lidar · 55 tagged · 4,124 derived-levels · 2,127 assumed ·
assumedFraction 0.337. The half-degree, not the tileset, is the whole difference. Quote the bbox
with the number or the two readings look like a contradiction.
⚠ THIS RECORD IS A PRE-BAKE BASELINE, DELIBERATELY — same posture as Murcia's. A buildings re-bake
is in flight on this SHA (heightSources.mjs / tools/context-bake/ are OWNED BY THAT RUN and were
not touched by this pass). Re-probe and update this block after it publishes. Do NOT edit these
counts to predict the outcome (§SIZE-IS-NOT-PROVENANCE — a green bake is precisely what L-658
produced while shipping nothing, and L-677's `--region` fix landed because a 4-hour green run had
published zero tiles).
⚠ 268 of 900 covering tiles are ABSENT and that is a MEASURED EMPTY, not a failure: 0 tiles failed
to read. They are sea, port water and Collserola, where the bake produced no building features.
